caption: The drawing depicts a single, weathered metal bell mounted on a bracket. The bell is a pale blue-green color, with patches of rust and wear in brown and reddish hues, indicating age and exposure. The bracket is an ornate, brownish metal structure that curves upward on both sides, with a handle extending to the left and a mounting plate at the bottom featuring two holes and a bolt. The bell's clapper is visible inside, colored a dark brown or black. The background is plain and off-white, and there is a small signature in the lower right reading "L.G. HARTMANN."
title: Bell
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
